summary: Domine Eduard Osok Airport (SOQ) is the principal air gateway to Sorong, the largest city in Indonesia's Southwest Papua province. It serves as the primary launch point for travelers heading to the world-famous Raja Ampat archipelago, one of the most biodiverse marine regions on Earth. The airport handles a mix of domestic flights connecting Sorong to major Indonesian hubs like Jakarta, Makassar, and Manado.
faqs:
Q: What is Domine Eduard Osok Airport best known for?
A: It is the main entry point for tourists traveling to Raja Ampat, widely considered one of the best diving destinations in the world.

Q: Which airlines operate at this airport?
A: Airlines including Garuda Indonesia, Lion Air, Sriwijaya Air, and Wings Air operate regular domestic services from the airport.

Q: How far is the airport from Sorong city center?
A: The airport is conveniently located just a few kilometers from central Sorong, typically a 15 to 20 minute drive.

Q: Are there international flights from Domine Eduard Osok Airport?
A: No, the airport primarily handles domestic flights; international travelers typically connect through Jakarta or Makassar.
transport_tips: Taxis and ride-hailing services are available outside the terminal and provide the most convenient way to reach hotels in Sorong. Pre-arranged hotel transfers are recommended for travelers continuing onward to Raja Ampat ferry terminals. Allow extra time during rainy season as road conditions can occasionally be affected by heavy tropical downpours.
local_tip: If you're heading to Raja Ampat, book domestic flights that arrive in the morning so you can catch the same-day ferry from Sorong harbor; the last boats to Waisai typically depart by early afternoon.
